summary: Four of six seats returned schema-valid responses at xhigh effort (Qwen and Gemini malformed); all four asked for revision. Four concerns reached two or more supporters: an ambiguous shared-entity join that GND reports unchecked would be decided by RP1 (all four seats), the agreement comparator cannot represent not-checked rules, RP2-C4 contradicts the changed textual line, and section 2's file list is incomplete. Codex alone raised the same-verdict conflict of D4 and Float precision for Number; Claude alone raised Ossie's shared lowering, the gnd check anchors route, the disconnected-join description, D5's missing criterion and RP5's unnamed populations.

agreed_concerns.title: RP1 lowers an ambiguous shared-entity join that GND reports unchecked
agreed_concerns.summary: A referenced fact type with two non-referenced roles of one object type makes GND report join-anchor-ambiguous (unchecked); plan r2 would bind both roles to one variable and decide the rule.

agreed_concerns.title: The named agreement comparator cannot represent not-checked rules
agreed_concerns.summary: _findings json-decodes the text after the status and _gnd drops an unchecked verdict with no offending facts, so RP2-C3 and RP5-C2 cannot be tested as written.

agreed_concerns.title: RP2-C4 keeps the textual line while sections 2 and 5 change it
agreed_concerns.summary: Section 2 prints the row's reason and the textual reason is its bare expression, so the textual line would change, contradicting RP2-C4.

agreed_concerns.title: Section 2's changed-file list omits commands/export.py and docs
agreed_concerns.summary: Section 2 says the phases change pyrel_rules.py only; section 3 and RP2-C5 also change commands/export.py and section 5 edits rules-as-pyrel.md.

prioritized_fixes.title: List ambiguous and disconnected joins as not checked
prioritized_fixes.action: Classify the external join as GND does before lowering; list a disconnected or ambiguous join as not checked with GND's reason; correct section 1 (GND reports both unchecked); add RP1-C6 and RP1-C7 oracle cases; run RP2 before RP1.

prioritized_fixes.title: Teach the comparator not-checked rules
prioritized_fixes.action: Extend _findings and _gnd to (rule, 'not checked', null) in RP2 with a negative control (RP2-C6) before any criterion relies on it.

prioritized_fixes.title: Scope same-verdict to accepted inputs; refuse unrepresentable ones
prioritized_fixes.action: Narrow section 0 to inputs the program accepts, make every unrepresentable input a by-name exit-3 refusal with a test pinning both exits (D4 non-string ids, D6 integers beyond 2**53 in Number and Float).

prioritized_fixes.title: Keep the textual line byte-identical
prioritized_fixes.action: Make the textual reason 'textual rule: <expression>' so RP2-C4 holds, and correct section 5.

prioritized_fixes.title: Name gnd check --anchors as the deciding route
prioritized_fixes.action: Correct section 1 and the anchored reason; define agreement against gnd check without a sidecar.

prioritized_fixes.title: Hold the Ossie export unchanged
prioritized_fixes.action: Add an Ossie-unchanged rule to section 0, name ossie_formulas.py as an affected consumer and run the Ossie tests in every lane.

prioritized_fixes.title: Test D5 in the default lane
prioritized_fixes.action: Add RP2-C7: the LQP report function, with the engine stubbed, prints the not-checked lines and returns D5's exit; --compile prints them too.

prioritized_fixes.title: Enumerate RP5's populations
prioritized_fixes.action: Add a population table with each population file and GND's measured exit.

prioritized_fixes.title: Measure anchor equality on a numeric anchor
prioritized_fixes.action: Add a numeric-anchor oracle case to the RP1 spec.

prioritized_fixes.title: Fix the file list and a citation path
prioritized_fixes.action: Make section 2's file list match sections 3 and 5, and cite representation-format.md from the repository root.
